title: Derived public summary: historical 2f startup phase observations

arithmetic.method: Arithmetic mean of exactly two process values for each cohort, scenario, side/flag and first phase occurrence; bytes divided by 1024 for KiB.

originalCohort.concurrentWorkDeclared: SDK static/tooling validation was still running when this diagnostic was dispatched; no phase CPU/timing claim or quiet-host inference is made.

flagMeaning.off: Explicit 0; existing eager layout queries enabled.
flagMeaning.on: Explicit 1; bypass the eager Monospace host-format query and hidden footer measurement.

controlledCohort.concurrentWorkDeclared: Concurrent SDK builds and a baseline build may be active; shared host is not quiet.

failedAttempt.exitCodeBasis: Root-reported native process outcome; no completed child outcome/exception record was emitted in this attempt.

win32Diagnosis.recordedObservation: In a process-local test, GetEnvironmentVariableW on a never-set variable returned length 0 and LastError 203. After .NET SetEnvironmentVariable(name, null, Process), it returned length 0 and LastError 0; the managed environment dictionary contained the variable. Explicit empty produced the same. This matches the helper's present-empty rejection and explains the off-slot pre-trace exit.

failedAttempt.flagRepair: r2 accepts explicit 0/1, retains absent as disabled and present-empty as invalid; explicit 0 requires trace opt-in. The runner restores original absence with Win32 deletion. The failed attempt and its manifests remain unchanged.

measurementBoundary.observer: The first record follows opening the trace handle. Thread enumeration and synchronous write/flush occur at every phase and are observer overhead.
measurementBoundary.primaryViewportComparison: The startup host pixels differ from the primary nominal DIP viewport. This trace does not emit DPI, so no startup-DIP conversion or matched-viewport claim is made.

interpretation: The original first ApplyTheme comparison is about 27 MiB higher before the first complete frame; the controlled on flag accompanies deferral of that early increase.
Final off/on private means are Compose 46868 to 47482 KiB and Split 47356 to 46902 KiB: there is no consistent retained-memory reduction.
First-frame configured-format counts are Compose 12 to 11 and Split 9 to 8; these counts do not explain byte ownership or establish a cost cause.
These sixteen diagnostic processes are separate from the fixed primary paired cohort and cannot replace its memory results.
No CPU, causal attribution, final production-source qualification, physical input/presentation, performance acceptance or policy acceptance is claimed.

Source and executable identities are quoted from retained private metadata. Private patches, native trace corpus and binaries are not published; hashes support integrity review, not independent replay without those private inputs.
